title: Jensen Huang Resigns as Nvidia CEO
summary:

title: Regret Paying $162 to Upgrade to Premium Class on Alaska Airlines
summary:

Then, I started writing about Alaska Airlines' — and the broader airline industry's — push to attract more premium customers.
Curious about this trend — and tempted by a $162 upgrade offered at check-in for my flight — I decided to test Alaska's current "Premium Class" product.
The upgrade from Main Cabin cost nearly as much as the flight itself.

title: Synchron Pauses Trials of Its Brain Implant Due to Performance Issues
summary:

Synchron is one of several companies developing brain-computer interface technology meant to allow people to control digital devices by reading brain signals and translating those signals into output commands.
The company has touted its technology, dubbed the Stentrode, as minimally invasive since it does not rest in the brain itself or require brain surgery.
Those sites have recently paused enrollment, however, because the device is not working as intended, according to sources familiar with the trials who asked to remain anonymous.
